hypothesis: An explicitly contradiction-aware trainable factual fast-weight write gate will adapt faster after hidden causal interventions while retaining stable action-effect relationships, using no more than the fixed all-write 256-float fast-state baseline.
null: No reproducible changed-role MSE improvement over the strongest eligible fixed method without unacceptable stable-role degradation.

data.generator: Exact frozen P69 nonstationary synthetic causal-shift generation logic, source code immutable; P76 split seeds and namespace disjoint from P69 P70 P75.
data.inputs: Only historical actually executed unit-normalized action 16D and actually observed effect 16D; query action provided only after writes and final consequence exclusively as scoring/training target.
data.private_audits: Role identity, hidden change-point, changed vs stable query are evaluator labels for stratified metrics, never model inputs.
data.sealed_ood: OOD cohorts inaccessible from development source selector and not generated/scored until separately project-owned admission; P68/P70 consumed OOD and P69/P75 FIT/VAL and P75 OOD sources not used.
data.frozen_disjointness: Hash ordered world fields, disjoint FIT/VAL source seed namespace, no query duplicate, index-only shortcut <=0.55, target quartile imbalance <=.05; seed changes prohibited after source birth.

state_budget.fast_memory: For every arm W is 16x16 = exactly 256 persistent float scalars per world, no hidden cursor, replayed history or extra per-world gradient state.
state_budget.process_compute: Measure total training/eval process wall, peak RAM, parameter counts and realized write operations separately; no equal-compute claim from 256-state parity alone.

frozen_arms.mechanism: W+=sigmoid(theta dot [1, log(MSE(y-Wa)+1e-6), log(mean((Wa)^2)+1e-6), cosine(Wa,y), ReLU(-cosine(Wa,y))*clamp(||Wa||/(||y||+1e-6),0,1)])*(y-Wa) outer a
frozen_arms.initialization: theta_i uniform(-0.05,0.05) with seeded CPU generator for each seed, independent per seed

training.checkpoint_selection: min total validation query MSE; no role-label-weighted training, select solely on total validation error
training.initialization: seeded independent theta vectors; identical FIT indices across seeds
training.early_stop: No premature nonconvergence claims; all 240 updates required unless nonfinite, custody or resource stop.
training.validation_competence: Every learned seed total VAL MSE <=0.75*zero reference, and finite complete 240-update fit, before any OOD scoring.
training.validation_signal: Against the best fixed control selected by total VAL MSE, changed-role VAL MSE improvement >=15% in each of three seeds, stable-role VAL MSE <=1.05*best_fixed_stable_mse. Any failure means strict P76 VAL FAIL; no OOD scoring.
training.negative_controls: Exactly matched all-write and fast-write stream and error, wrong-action-credit must make >=1.2x learned gate MSE using an independent locked action permutation, random gate matched to learned FIT write rate only; local negative engineering tests before scoring.

science_gate.development_ood: After FIT/VAL competency, source integrity, all negative controls, exact-source full original Linux/Windows regression and project-owned separate authority, 3 new independent authored OOD-DEV cohorts, candidate improvement >=10% against strongest fixed eligible baseline on each of 3 seeds x3 cohorts, and stable-role error <=1.05 baseline, positive paired 5000-world-bootstrap 95% lower bound.
science_gate.independent_science: No SCIENTIFIC_PASS from authored synthetic data alone. Requires qualified independent factual action-consequence first use, separately fully-trained conventional controls with matched actions/information and compute, cold retention and novel transfer.
science_gate.failures: Preserve all negative and nonconvergent outputs; do not tune thresholds based on consumed holdout. Any missing whole-platform regression or source admission prevents research promotion.

engineering.pre_source: Freeze this file before new implementation/source code; append no post-result threshold changes to frozen protocol.
engineering.focused_tests: State budget, nonfinite/malformed/future-label rejection, read before write, no privileged labels, cold restore bitwise, definite contradiction response versus no contradiction, deterministic init, independent model seeds, finite gradients and negative action-credit.
engineering.original_ci: Mandatory exact-final-SHA Windows/Ubuntu full original G4/G5/G7 and build only via approved native route; 0-step GitHub-hosted jobs are INFRA UNVERIFIED.
